name: Drogon C++ Development Environment
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake git uuid-dev zlib1g-dev libssl-dev libjsoncpp-dev
updateContentCommand: if [ ! -d "drogon" ]; then git clone https://github.com && cd drogon && git submodule update --init && mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && make -j$(nproc) && sudo make install && cd ../..; fi
